messages:
mike-support: Hey team — enterprise customer (acme-corp) on Dedicated hit a 413 when calling /v1/rerank. They sent a very long user query (~12k chars) + ~600 docs. Customer is blocked and asking why the error doesn't say what to change. Request-id: rq_0a1b2c3d.

jess-eng: Can you paste the exact request payload (sanitized) and the raw error body? Also which model + rerank endpoint variant (v1/rerank vs v1/score) were they calling?

mike-support: Pasted below (removed PII). They called POST /v1/rerank with body: ```json
{
  "query": "<~12000 chars>...",
  "documents": ["<doc1 long text>", "<doc2>", ..., "<doc600>"]
}
```
Response: HTTP/1.1 413 Payload Too Large
Body: ```json
{ "error": "request entity too large" }
```
No additional fields. Model: rdx-compact-ranker-v1.

leo-ux: Oof — the error is very opaque. Customer expects: "Your query or document set exceeds our per-request limits. Try trimming docs to N per request or shorten the query." Can we add helpful fields in the error body? e.g., max_docs, max_query_chars, or a link to docs. :thumbsup:

ariane-product: We should be careful exposing internal caps but providing actionable guidance is fair. Recommended interim: update error to return a structured hint like {"type":"payload_too_large","max_docs":250,"max_query_tokens":4096,"help":"https://redwood.dev/docs/rerank-limits"}. Is that feasible?

jess-eng: Triage notes: current 413 originates at the API gateway (nginx) before payload reaches the rerank service, so API gateway needs a richer response. Two options: 1) change gateway to add hint fields for known endpoints, 2) accept large payloads and let service validate and return structured errors. Option 1 is faster. I'll open a small gateway PR to return a JSON with hint fields for rerank and score endpoints.

mike-support: Customer needs a workaround ASAP. What's the interim support message I can send? Also any repro steps we can give them to reliably hit the error so they can validate after we change messaging?

jess-eng: Interims: (1) Slice their document set into batches of <=200 docs per request and rerank each batch, then merge scores client-side. (2) Truncate or summarize the user's query to under ~4k tokens (approx 3–4k chars is not the same as tokens; recommend using tokenizers). Example python chunking snippet: ```python
# naive chunker: split docs into batches of 200
def chunk_docs(docs, size=200):
    for i in range(0, len(docs), size):
        yield docs[i:i+size]
```
Curl repro (sanitized): ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"query":"'"$(printf 'x%.0s' {1..12000})"'","documents":['"$(yes 'a' | head -n 600 | jq -R -s -c 'split("\n")[:-1]')"']}' -v
```
That will reproduce the gateway 413 quickly.

leo-ux: For support copy, try: "You're receiving 413 Payload Too Large — your query and/or document set exceeds per-request limits. Try reducing the number of documents per request (suggested ≤200), shorten or summarize the query, or send documents in smaller batches. See: https://redwood.dev/docs/rerank-limits" Short, actionable.

ariane-product: Good. Also add a proactive note in the docs showing chunking + merge pattern for customers with large corpora. Can eng add a small code example for merging ranked batches?

jess-eng: I'll add a merge example to the docs and link to it in the gateway hint. Quick merge approach: combine all scored items and sort by score descending, do dedup by id, then pick top-K. I can draft a snippet for the docs PR.

support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-897. Assigned to jess-eng (eng), leo-ux (docs/ux), and mike-support (CS). ETA for gateway hint change: 48h if no regressions.

mike-support: Thanks — I'll send the interim copy to the customer and include the curl repro. Please @jess-eng once the gateway PR is merged so we can confirm the improved error body.

jess-eng: Will do. Quick follow-ups: confirm exact numeric caps with product (ariane) so the gateway hint is accurate. For Dedicated customers we may be able to expose higher per-request caps; will note this in the error message as tier-aware hints.

ariane-product: I will confirm Dedicated caps and post back here by EOD.

mike-support: Great. Marking this thread for follow-up and escalation until gateway message lands. Thanks all.
